title: My AI rockets crashed for 5 generations. Gen 13: 57 landed
caption:
AI learns lander, part 2.

My AI rockets crashed every time for 5 generations. Gen 6: the first one landed. Gen 7: 8. Gen 8: 37. Gen 13: 57. Each rocket is a small neural network that fires its thrusters; the best landers get copied with mutations.

title: 41 AIs balanced the pole. I shoved them and 0 did. 12 generations later, 38
caption:
AI learns pole, part 3.

41 AIs learned to balance a pole by gen 4. Then I shoved them and all 41 dropped it. Gen 7: 2 survived the shove. Gen 10: 20. Gen 17: 38. Each AI is a small neural network; the ones that balance longest get copied with mutations.

title: My AI wolves got to 38 catches. Then the rabbits learned too
caption:
AI learns hunt, part 2.

My AI wolves went from 16 catches to 38 by gen 16. At gen 19 the rabbits started evolving too. Gen 23: 32. Gen 30: 19. Gen 36: 18. Wolves and rabbits are small neural networks; the best of each get copied with mutations.
